findings: Health payload marks _HEALTH_CHECK; installed prefill handler has no marker-specific path and always configures prefill KV handoff.
Expiry warnings start thirty seconds after prefill health task and continue at one request/second after the benchmark has exited; TP2 counts each lease twice.
NIXL expiry is recorded separately from failed transfers and no late notifications were observed.
Exact per-canary request tracing was not introduced into this frozen campaign.
